headline: Hedge-driven GAAP loss masks underlying operating growth
summary_short: Equitable Holdings reported a GAAP net loss of $453M (-$1.68 per share) in Q2 2026 on non-cash derivative and market-risk-benefit swings from its variable-annuity hedge book, even as Non-GAAP operating EPS rose 24% y/y to $1.70 and the Company returned $449M to shareholders.
summary_long: GAAP net loss widened to $453M (-$1.68/share) from -$349M y/y, driven by a swing to $2,055M of net derivative losses and MRB remeasurement on the variable-annuity book -- not weaker underlying earnings. Non-GAAP operating earnings, stripping that hedge volatility, rose to $488M ($1.70/share, $1.75 ex notable items) on higher Retirement fee revenue and AB base fees. AUM/A hit a record $1.2 trillion, up 10% y/y. The Company returned $449M to shareholders ($83M dividends, $366M buybacks), on track for its 60-70% FY2026 payout target, and continues targeting $1.8B of 2026 cash generation. Equity attributable to Holdings fell to -$785M on a larger AOCI deduction. The Corebridge merger, shareholder-approved July 30th, stays on track to close by year-end.

drivers.explanation: The release attributes the net loss mainly to derivative and market-risk-benefit fair-value swings from variable-annuity hedging, not core profitability; Non-GAAP operating earnings, which exclude that volatility, rose y/y on higher fee revenue.

Total revenues fell to $1,658M from $2,362M y/y and $4,230M q/q, driven mainly by net derivative losses swinging to $(2,055)M from $(1,374)M y/y -- a hedge/MRB accounting effect, not a business slowdown.

The Company's own reconciliation isolates $1,522M of post-tax variable-annuity-related adjustments this quarter versus $934M y/y, explaining the swing from Non-GAAP operating profit to a reported GAAP net loss.

Pretax loss widened as net derivative losses and market-risk-benefit remeasurement outpaced net investment income and fee revenue, per the release's own Non-GAAP reconciliation of hedge-related adjustments.
Tracks the net income swing to a loss plus a $13M preferred dividend, on a roughly flat 278.3M weighted average share count.
Same net income swing and preferred dividend as basic EPS; the loss is anti-dilutive so diluted and basic share counts are identical this quarter.
not explained in the release; debt was roughly flat q/q at $3,839M vs $3,837M but down from $4,332M a year earlier

Total equity attributable to Holdings fell mainly on a larger AOCI deduction (-$6,465M); book value per common share including AOCI was $(6.79), consistent with the release's own balance-sheet statistics.
Weighted share count fell y/y and q/q as the Company repurchased $366M of stock in the quarter, consistent with its disclosed capital-return program.
